person.description: Canonical name of the public figure.

public_figure.description: true only for a widely known public figure (living or historical adult) with an extensive public record.

refusal.description: Set (and leave nodes empty) when the request is not a public figure, is a minor, or cannot be answered from the public record.

domain.description: Field and era, a few words.

summary.description: One or two sentences: the mind in a nutshell.

id.description: Short unique slug, e.g. core, e1, s4, a10.

content.description: The insight itself, 2 to 4 sentences, specific to this person.

directive.description: How an interface generated THROUGH this node must look and behave: palette, tone, layout, emphasis, interactions. 1 to 3 sentences.

evidence.description: The public fact, statement or work this node rests on (no URL, no invented quote).

date.description: Artifacts only: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD.

impact.description: Artifacts only: how this event shaped the core.

keywords.description: empreinte_syntaxique only: signature words or phrasings.
